The Command Platform difference
The Rapid7 Command Platform is built to help security teams move faster. Powered by real-time threat intelligence and AI-driven insight, it unifies visibility, predictive context, and real-time response. Amplified by data integration, automation, and expert support, it eliminates slowdowns and guesswork—so your team doesn’t just keep up, you stay ahead.
Because in security, speed isn’t optional. It’s everything.
Gain visibility and predictive power
There’s confidence in seeing everything—and power in knowing what’s next. Full attack surface visibility, AI, and threat intelligence combine to reveal risk and predict attacker moves—so you’re always ahead.
